run_command 'cd /home/msi-command/Desktop/projects/affiliate\ sites/utilityexplained && python3 -c "
import re, os
# Count $ ranges and % figures per blog file to identify price-dense pages
blog = 'content/blog'
results = []
for fn in sorted(os.listdir(blog)):
    if not fn.endswith('.md'): continue
    path = os.path.join(blog, fn)
    text = open(path, encoding='utf-8').read()
    dollar_ranges = re.findall(r'\$\d[\d]*(?:–|-|to|\s*[-–]\s*)\$?\d[\d]*', text)
    dollar_singles = re.findall(r'\$\d[\d]*(?:\.\d+)?', text)
    cents = re.findall(r'\d+(?:\.\d+)?\s*¢/kWh|\d+(?:\.\d+)?\s*âŒ¢/kWh|\d+(?:\.\d+)?\s*\b[¢c]\/kWh', text)
    pcts = re.findall(r'\d+(?:\.\d+)?\s*%', text)
    results.append((fn, len(dollar_ranges), len(dollar_singles), len(cents), len(pcts)))
results.sort(key=lambda x: -x[1])
print('top by dollar-range count:')
for r in results[:25]:
    print(f'  {r[0]}  ranges={r[1]} singles={r[2]} cents={r[3]} pcts={r[4]}')
"' -> exit 1
